REDMINE_BASE_URL.description: Base URL of your Redmine instance (e.g. https://redmine.example.com)

REDMINE_API_KEY.title: Redmine API key
REDMINE_API_KEY.description: Your personal Redmine API access key

REDMINE_BILLABLE_HOURS_FIELD_ID.title: Billable hours field ID

REDMINE_SSE_API_KEY.title: Redmine SSE gateway API key

REDMINE_SSE_URL.title: Redmine SSE gateway URL
REDMINE_SSE_URL.description: SSE endpoint URL for the team Redmine MCP gateway

GOOGLE_SHEETS_CREDENTIALS_PATH.title: Google OAuth credentials path
GOOGLE_SHEETS_CREDENTIALS_PATH.description: Absolute path to the Google OAuth client JSON file

GOOGLE_SHEETS_TOKEN_PATH.description: Writable path where the OAuth refresh token is cached
